title: 第25章 我看谁敢动她第26章 一招重伤内院大长老
slug: 我装了三年废物出手人间无敌
content_zh:
“你可知天魔教圣女是天魔教修炼天赋最好的人？”
楚云道：“这个我好像听说过。”
北灵院长道：“天魔老怪对她很看重，一旦我杀了她，天魔教肯定会对我们北灵学院进行疯狂报复。”
“到那时，恐怕我们北灵学院就会在青州消失。”
听到这话，楚云释然。
作为一方势力大佬，肯定要以大局为重。
如果因为杀死一个天魔教圣女，就遭来无法接受的报复，的确不划算。
“对了，你怎么招惹上天魔教了？”
北灵院长问道。
楚云道：“这件事说来话长。”
当下他将自己之前的经历，全部告诉北灵院长。
北灵院长听完后，说道：“这也不怪你，换作别人也会这么做。”
“只是以后你要多加小心，天魔教估计不会善罢甘休。”
楚云道：“我倒无所谓，我只是担心我的家族。”
北灵院长道：“这个你尽管放心，我会派一名天武境武者来保护你的家族，你只需要全力修炼就行。”
现在楚云是他们北灵学院的希望，他可不希望楚云在别的事情上分心。
“多谢院长。”
楚云听到这话，心中顿时安稳很多。
有天武境强者保护他的家族，他就可以安心修炼了。
“好了，我先走了，你处理完家族的事情，就尽快回来。”

北灵院长说完，身影一闪，便消失不见。
待到北灵院长离开，楚啸天道：“云儿，看来他们很看重你。”
楚云道：“他们对我的期待很高。”
楚啸天道：“既然如此，那你就要好好修炼，毕竟这次要不是人家出手，恐怕我们楚家就完了。”
楚云道：“放心吧爹，我知道怎么做。”
“楚云，你可不要忘记你答应我的事。”
就在这时，灰袍老者看着楚云说道。
楚云道：“你放心，只要你全力帮助我楚家，我会想办法让你成为四级阵法。”
“好，有你这句话就足够了。”
现在楚云已经是天武境，他相信距离武王境已经不远了。
“少爷，你修为这么高，能不能指点我们？”
“是啊，我们到现在都还没有突破到元武境。”
这时，不少楚家的年轻族人看着楚云问道。
楚啸天看着楚云道：“之前派出去找你的那九十八人，都是他们的长辈，现在他们已死，爹希望你花点时间指点他们，毕竟你现在可是他们奋斗的目标。”
楚云道：“行，我用三天时间指点他们，就当是报答他们长辈对楚家作出的贡献。”
“好。”
接下来的三天时间，楚云都在指点楚家年轻一代的族人学习。
并且把七星无影拳和天罡剑法两本地级武技，也留在楚家。
他现在已经是天武境，地级武技对他来说已经没什么用了。
做完这些后，楚云才返回北灵学院。

这次楚家能够化险为夷，可以说还要多亏叶灵儿。
content_en:
"Did you know that the Saint of the Heavenly Demon Sect is the most talented person in the Heavenly Demon Sect?"
Chu Yun said: "I seem to have heard of this."
Dean Beiling said: "Old Demon of Heavenly Demon values her very much. Once I kill her, Demonic Cult will definitely take crazy revenge on our Beiling Academy."
"By then, I'm afraid our Beiling Academy will disappear in Qingzhou."
Hearing this, Chu Yun was relieved.
As the leader of a party, you must put the overall situation first.
It is indeed not cost-effective to suffer unacceptable retaliation for killing a Holy Girl from the Heavenly Demon Cult.
"By the way, why did you provoke the Demon Cult?"
Dean Beiling asked.
Chu Yun said: "This matter is a long story."
At that moment, he told Dean Beiling all about his previous experiences.
After hearing this, Dean Beiling said: "It's not your fault, others would do the same thing."
"It's just that you have to be more careful in the future. The Demon Sect probably won't let it go."
Chu Yun said: "I don't care, I'm just worried about my family."
Dean Beiling said: "Don't worry, I will send a Tianwu realm warrior to protect your family. You just need to practice with all your strength."
Now Chu Yun is the hope of their Beiling Academy, and he doesn't want Chu Yun to be distracted by other things.
"Thank you, Dean."
When Chu Yun heard this, he felt much more at ease.
With a strong man in the Tianwu Realm protecting his family, he can practice with peace of mind.
"Okay, I'll leave first. You can come back as soon as possible after handling the family affairs."
After Dean Beiling finished speaking, his figure flashed and disappeared.
After Dean Beiling left, Chu Xiaotian said: "Yun'er, it seems they value you very much."
Chu Yun said: "They have high expectations for me."
Chu Xiaotian said: "In that case, you must practice hard. After all, if someone hadn't taken action this time, our Chu family would have been doomed."
Chu Yun said: "Don't worry, Dad, I know what to do."
"Chu Yun, don't forget what you promised me."
At this moment, the old man in gray robe looked at Chu Yun and said.
Chu Yun said: "Don't worry, as long as you try your best to help my Chu family, I will find a way to make you a fourth-level formation."
"Okay, your words are enough."
Now that Chu Yun has reached the Tianwu realm, he believes that he is not far from the Martial King realm.
"Master, your cultivation level is so high, can you give us some advice?"
"Yes, we haven't broken through to the Yuanwu realm yet."
At this time, many young members of the Chu family looked at Chu Yun and asked.
Chu Xiaotian looked at Chu Yun and said: "The ninety-eight people who were sent to find you before are all their elders. Now that they are dead, I hope you will take some time to guide them. After all, you are the target of their struggle now."
Chu Yun said: "Okay, I will give them three days of guidance as a way of repaying their elders for their contributions to the Chu family."
"Okay."
In the next three days, Chu Yun spent his time teaching the younger generation of the Chu family.
He also kept two local martial arts skills, Seven Star Shadowless Fist and Tiangang Sword Technique, in the Chu family.
He is now in the Heavenly Martial Realm, and Earth-level martial arts are of little use to him.
After doing this, Chu Yun returned to Beiling College.
It can be said that the Chu family was able to turn danger into safety this time, thanks to Ye Ling'er.
